diy-plywood-shelving.name: DIY plywood shelving
diy-plywood-shelving.description: Self-built open shelving from 18 mm plywood: side panels + inner uprights (bays), evenly spaced shelves, 4 mm hardboard back for rigidity. Freestanding, wood-to-wood screws only. Keep bays ≤ ~80 cm so 18 mm shelves don't sag.

source.notes: Sheet sizes in Israel: 122 x 244 cm (plywood 18 mm, hardboard/MDF 3-4 mm).

diy-wall-bed-desk.name: DIY wall bed + fold-down desk on a storage base
diy-wall-bed-desk.description: Self-built: low storage base (pillows, bedding), a board with an existing bed frame top + mattress that stands up against the wall and swings down onto gravity fold-out legs, and a desk hinged on the bed's underside with its own legs. Double-click the bed or desk: desk out → desk folded → guest bed. Both need a lock (bed up, desk folded) so nothing can fall.

source.notes: Mark's design; bed frame 140 x 190 (his existing frame top). Hinges, locks and legs are placeholders for real hardware.
